name: Preventive Dentistry & Daily Oral Hygiene — Evidence-Informed Guide
description: Practical, guideline-aligned prevention for caries and gingival disease: fluoride use, brushing and interdental cleaning, sealants, diet counseling, tobacco cessation, professional prophylaxis, recall intervals, and special populations (children, pregnancy, diabetes, xerostomia).
keywords: preventive dentistry, fluoride toothpaste, fluoride varnish, dental sealants, interdental cleaning, floss, interdental brushes, diet counseling, tobacco cessation, prophylaxis, recall interval, caries prevention, gingivitis prevention

hasPart.name: Toothbrushing Technique (2× daily, 2 minutes)
hasPart.description: Simple steps for effective plaque removal with soft-bristled brush and fluoride toothpaste.

supply.name: Fluoride toothpaste (pea-sized for adults; smear/pea for children as advised)

step.text: Place brush at 45° to gumline; use small circular or gentle vibratory strokes.
Systematically brush outer, inner, and chewing surfaces of all teeth.
Brush along gumline; avoid aggressive scrubbing that can cause recession.
Spit; avoid rinsing immediately to maximize fluoride contact time.

hasPart.name: Interdental Cleaning (Daily)
hasPart.description: Floss or interdental brushes to disrupt plaque between teeth and reduce gingival bleeding.

supply.name: Interdental brushes (size matched to spaces, as advised)

step.text: Gently pass floss/brush between contact points without snapping.
Curve floss in a C-shape against each surface; move up-down below the gumline.
For interdental brushes, use the largest comfortable size and move back-and-forth once or twice.

hasPart.name: Dietary Counseling to Reduce Cariogenic Frequency
hasPart.description: Limit frequency of free sugars; water or milk preferred; manage acidic beverages; avoid bedtime sugars for children.

possibleTreatment.name: Counseling on meal timing and beverage choices

hasPart.name: Pit and Fissure Sealants (Children & High-risk Adults)
hasPart.description: Resin or glass-ionomer sealants on permanent molars reduce occlusal caries risk, especially in children and high-risk patients.

possibleTreatment.name: Resin-based sealant placement on sound, high-risk pits/fissures

hasPart.name: Professional Prophylaxis & Risk-Based Recall
hasPart.description: Plaque/tartar removal and personalized recall intervals based on caries/periodontal risk and patient factors.

hasPart.name: Paediatric Prevention
hasPart.guidelineSubject: Fluoride use, sealants, diet, caregiver involvement

hasPart.name: Pregnancy & Oral Health
hasPart.guidelineSubject: Hygiene optimization and safe routine care
hasPart.description: Prevention and routine dental care are generally safe during pregnancy; focus on plaque control, diet, and nausea/erosion management.

hasPart.name: Diabetes & Periodontal Risk Reduction
hasPart.description: Optimized oral hygiene and professional care support periodontal health; coordinate with diabetes care for glycaemic control.
